name: Raffles Udaipur
positioning: The first Raffles hotel in India, a Palladian-inspired resort on a 21-acre private island on Udai Sagar Lake, with further rooms and suites on the lakeshore
best_for: Travelers who want a private-island stay reached by boat
Couples looking for suites with a private plunge pool and lake views
Guests interested in Rajputana royal cuisine and Mewari culture

facts.text: Raffles Udaipur is the first Raffles hotel in India.
The resort spans a private island and a lakeshore, and a stay begins with a boat ride.
The resort is 20 minutes from the airport.
A limousine takes guests from the airport to a lakeside pavilion, where a private boat transfer waits.
Local Mewari elements such as jali panels and Tikri artwork appear across the design.
All rooms have a balcony with lake views; many have a private pool, a garden or both.
Every suite has a panoramic view of the lake.
Raffles Butlers are available 24 hours a day.
Raffles Spa pairs ayurveda-inspired healing practices with contemporary wellness treatments.
The spa's Presidential Couples Suite has a steam area, sauna, Jacuzzi and a private balcony overlooking the lake.
The Voyagers Den offers badminton, table tennis, pool, board games, PS 5 and croquet.
Evenings can begin with an Evening Aarti by Udai Sagar Lake, followed by folk music and traditional dance performances.

highlights.text: Raffles Udaipur is set on a 21-acre private island.
The principal building is inspired by classical European Palladian architecture, with domes and high ceilings, surrounded by Baroque gardens.
Sawai Kitchen serves rediscovered heirloom recipes from the Rajputana royal households, using local seasonal produce and traditional cooking techniques.
Suites have a manicured garden and a private plunge pool.
Lakeshore Accommodation offers rooms and suites in non-island Lakeshore residences overlooking Udai Sagar Lake, with access to island dining and experiences.

considerations.text: Lakeshore Accommodation is in non-island residences, not on the private island itself.
Arrival from the airport ends with a private boat transfer from a lakeside pavilion.
The hotel gives September to March as the ideal time to visit, when the weather is pleasant for outdoor activities.
